evidence.title: Control and exception register
facts: SMB signing not required on FILE04; SMB1 disabled across W05
Twelve E02 sensors stale; ten E02 devices have local admin exception
W15 vendor exception retains NTLM for a service account; password last rotated 180 days before snapshot
W15 patch approval recorded 60 days before snapshot; installed KBs unknown in v1.0

evidence.title: Business impact and recovery worksheet
facts: Identity outage blocks new logins for 1000 staff
ERP supports 300 staff; outage > 4h delays orders and invoicing
Finance holds payroll and banking data for 1,000 employees
evidence.limitations: Synthetic RTO/RPO targets; not risk ratings.

asset.notes: Two HQ, two recovery site. No public LDAP or RDP.
Normally powered off; excluded from routine network reachability. Patched when last powered on (2026-06).
Separate admin accounts; user endpoints cannot reach these hosts.
Internet-exposed indirectly through WAF (N03) and reverse proxy (L01). 12,000 customer accounts.

evidence.title: Group scenario adaptation: assumptions A1-A15
evidence.limitations: Group assumptions, not scenario facts. Lower confidence when decisive.

evidence.title: Group scenario adaptation: version and patch data
facts: OS builds, last cumulative update months and software versions per asset, using real vendor release numbers current as of 2026-10-01
W15: Windows Server 2016 build 10.0.14393.9339 (July 2026 update, KB5099535)
Other Windows Server 2022 servers: build 10.0.20348.5622 (September 2026, KB5122882), except offline root CA at 10.0.20348.5256 (June 2026)
E02: 28 devices at 10.0.19045.7725 (September 2026); 12 stale-sensor devices unknown
evidence.limitations: Version assignment to Northbridge assets is simulated; version numbers are real releases.

evidence.title: Asset register
facts: 1000 endpoints, 60 server VMs, 6 hypervisors, 32 appliances, 40 APs, 30 printers
evidence.limitations: Cohort level; does not assert identical settings on every host.

evidence.title: Network design and reviewed access policy
facts: Unlisted inter-zone traffic and unsolicited Internet ingress denied by default
No Internet-facing RDP, SMB, LDAP, SQL or appliance management
evidence.limitations: Summarized flows; not a deployable firewall config.

evidence.title: Telemetry coverage summary
facts: AD, M365, firewall and VPN logs retained 90 days
Twelve E02 sensor heartbeats older than 7 days
